reels.caption:
Living the dream in beautiful Bora Bora 🌴

SAVE this bucketlist hotel for your future dream trip here! 🌺

When you arrive at @stregisborabora you know you have entered paradise. From the moment the boat drops you off at this iconic hotel, you are taken care of by the kindest staff. Your personal butler takes you on a golf cart to your massive overwater villa— they are the largest bungalows in French Polynesia! 🙌🏼

Imagine getting coffees delivered to your room in the morning, then riding your bike over the water and through the palm trees to the most delicious beachfront breakfast. ☕️

In the afternoon, you relax on an overwater hammock in the crystal clear lagoon, sip a cocktail by the pool, and snorkle alongside the incredible resident Napoleon fish named Moana! 🐟

INSIDER TIP: 2 things you can't miss doing at the St. Regis Resort in Bora Bora…

💦 Jet-ski around the island— you won't believe your eyes when you see the water color as it changes to the most stunning shades of blue!

💆🏼‍♀️ Unwind at the spa set on the most gorgeous lagoonarium— sip champagne after your treatment with views of Mt. Otemanu and brilliant turquoise water.
